name: Walkabout Mini Golf: Homestar Runner Distraction Pack
summary:
Everybody! Everybody! It’s just like, one minute, you’re thinking about miniature golf…and the next minute, you ARE miniature golf!

This DLC, unlike previous releases, is not a course, but a takeover of Walkabout by Strong Bad and friends featuring designs, in-game character appearances, voice-acting, and much more directly from The Brothers Chaps. It contains unique cosmetics, never-before-seen mini-games, and locations/nods to the most iconic Homestar Runner bits of all time.
